meta.name: Single-VM installed, previous release
meta.description: Install the release before the candidate from the registry (as a relay has it), for the upgrade suite's Panel Update.

HOST_IP.description: Static IP of the single-VM host (auto-injected by the tier runner from ctx.vmIps[host]).

sections.label: Install the previous Lamaste release via create-lamaste

steps.label: Install the release before the registry's latest create-lamaste
Patch panel.json IP to match the VM static IP
steps.bash:
set -euo pipefail
HOST_IP='{{HOST_IP}}'
if [ -n "${HOST_IP}" ]; then
  sed -i "s/\"ip\": *\"[^\"]*\"/\"ip\": \"${HOST_IP}\"/" /etc/lamalibre/lamaste/panel.json
fi

steps.label: Restart lamalibre-lamaste-serverd to pick up the patched IP
